seo.title: Privacy policy
seo.description: How the Cameraman app and this website handle your data: the app collects nothing, and recordings never leave your Mac.

sections.body:
**The Cameraman app does not collect, send or share any personal data.** It has no account, no analytics, no tracking and no third-party SDKs that collect data.

## Your recordings stay on your Mac

Recordings, projects, captions and exports are saved only on your Mac, and the app works offline. Cameraman uses the camera, microphone and screen only when you start a recording.

## Transcription runs on your Mac

Speech is transcribed on-device. The audio is never sent to a server.

## The AI assistant

The assistant inside the app runs the Claude Code you already have installed and signed in. Your requests, and the project details the assistant reads to answer them, go to Anthropic through your own Claude Code session, under [Anthropic's privacy policy](https://www.anthropic.com/legal/privacy) and your plan. Cameraman never sees that conversation or your login, and you can use the app without the assistant.

## The MCP server

The optional built-in MCP server runs on your Mac and only accepts AI apps you connect on that Mac. It edits your local project files and sends nothing anywhere. What those apps send to their own providers is covered by their policies.

## Update checks

The app can check for new versions by asking the public GitHub Releases API for the list of releases. The request carries no personal information. GitHub sees your IP address, as with any web request.

## This website

This site has no analytics, no cookies and no tracking scripts. The host keeps standard server logs, such as IP address and pages requested, to run and protect the service. Downloads come from GitHub, under [GitHub's privacy statement](https://docs.github.com/en/site-policy/privacy-policies/github-general-privacy-statement).

## Changes

If this policy changes, the new version is published here with a new date.

## Contact

Questions about this policy: [support@dpeluche.dev](mailto:support@dpeluche.dev).
